linux.symbol_policy_note: Requirements (DT_VERNEED), not strings or exported definitions, are checked in every ELF. GLIBCXX/CXXABI ceilings are an explicit GCC-8-era libstdc++ policy, not an implication of the glibc ceiling. Non-numeric requirements such as GLIBC_PRIVATE or GLIBC_ABI_DT_RELR fail closed.
linux.external_library_policy_note: This is an explicit permitted host-runtime catalog, not a claim that all libraries are needed, present, ABI-compatible, or loaded by each build. The per-artifact audit enumerates actual DT_NEEDED entries. Bundled libraries must resolve via relocatable ORIGIN search paths and are audited themselves. Undeclared external dependencies fail.

observed_gpui_direct_dependencies.scope: Prior local x86_64 debug artifact linked with the pinned dependencies; evidence only for runtime-prerequisite planning, not the P4 release or oldest supported OS.

runtime_prerequisites.system_libraries: Install the libraries reported as external-system for the specific package, including their distribution-provided transitive dependencies. No host ldd result establishes the minimum supported distribution.
runtime_prerequisites.display: A working X11 or Wayland session and the matching keyboard/window-system libraries are required; headless binary auditing does not test either path.
runtime_prerequisites.graphics: wgpu 29.0.4/GPUI require a working supported graphics backend, loader and compatible driver. Vulkan/EGL/GL libraries may be loaded dynamically and are not guaranteed to appear in DT_NEEDED. Driver/GPU compatibility is separate from glibc and remains unvalidated.
runtime_prerequisites.desktop_services: Fonts/fontconfig and desktop portals (including file-picker integration) can be runtime prerequisites not fully represented by ELF linkage. Verify them on each claimed desktop environment.

linux.build_image_provenance: Digest pins retrieved from the official Quay repository API on 2026-10-18; image build date 2026-10-16. A manylinux build image alone does not establish application ABI, GUI, or driver compatibility.

macos.policy_note: Every Mach-O slice is checked, including the main executable, dprint and packaged dylibs. LC_BUILD_VERSION/LC_VERSION_MIN_MACOSX are necessary static evidence only. Deployment-target flags cannot retroactively lower dependency load commands or establish availability of used APIs.

windows.crt_policy_note: Normal and delay-import CRT libraries are reported per PE. VC runtime imports must resolve to matching-architecture DLLs included in the distribution; a clean Windows 10 installation is not assumed to provide the Visual C++ Redistributable. UCRT/API sets are treated as Windows 10 system requirements. Static CRT configuration is not inferred from build flags. DLL names and PE subsystem versions do not prove availability of imported symbols on the desired Windows version.

unins000.exe.role: Inno Setup uninstaller; not application runtime
unins000.exe.note: The exact helper is still parsed and its imports are audited. A non-native helper requires Windows emulation; successful installation/uninstallation on the desired OS remains unvalidated.

icuuc.dll.availability: Microsoft documents icuuc.dll as a Windows system DLL introduced in Windows 10 version 1703. Version 1709 introduced the combined icu.h header; the separate combined icu.dll arrived in 1903. The exact icuuc.dll import is within the desired Windows 10 22H2 baseline.

pdh.dll.availability: Microsoft lists Pdh.dll for PdhOpenQueryW and a minimum supported Windows XP desktop client, preceding the desired Windows 10 22H2 baseline.

uiautomationcore.dll.availability: Microsoft lists Uiautomationcore.dll for UiaGetReservedNotSupportedValue and a minimum supported Windows XP client, preceding the desired Windows 10 22H2 baseline.

gdiplus.dll.availability: Microsoft lists Gdiplus.dll for GdiplusStartup and Windows XP/Windows 2000 Professional desktop clients, preceding the desired Windows 10 22H2 baseline.

mpr.dll.availability: Microsoft lists Mpr.dll for WNetAddConnection2W and a minimum supported Windows 2000 Professional desktop client, preceding the desired Windows 10 22H2 baseline.

windowscodecs.dll.availability: Microsoft lists Windowscodecs.dll for WICConvertBitmapSource and Windows XP SP2/Windows Vista clients. Its Windows Imaging Component overview confirms WIC is available in Windows Vista and later, preceding the desired Windows 10 22H2 baseline.

shcore.dll.availability: Microsoft lists Shcore.dll for GetDpiForMonitor and a minimum supported Windows 8.1 desktop client, preceding the desired Windows 10 22H2 baseline.

windows.external_library_evidence_scope: These exact OS-DLL entries were encountered in native Windows CI imports (dprint: pdh.dll; CodeStyles: icuuc.dll, uiautomationcore.dll, gdiplus.dll; installed Inno unins000.exe: mpr.dll, windowscodecs.dll, shcore.dll). Microsoft DLL availability evidence does not establish availability of every imported symbol, native ARM64 behavior, or application runtime acceptance on Windows 10 22H2. No Visual C++ Redistributable DLL is added to the OS catalog.

audit_limitations: Static audit success is not minimum-OS certification. validated_minimum_os stays null until separately recorded native testing on the claimed minimum OS.

OS API availability, CPU instruction requirements, runtime-loaded libraries/plugins, external libraries' own dependencies, display servers, graphics backends, GPU drivers and interactive behavior are not fully established by binary metadata.
The six native CI lanes must run the exact final binaries. Newer-host execution and parity checks do not validate older operating systems.
All native files are found by magic, independent of filename. Unsupported or malformed native headers fail; this audit does not execute target code or resolve dependencies against the audit host.

Dependency resolution follows each packaged executable separately. Unreferenced Windows DLLs have no proven process loader context and cannot satisfy non-system imports by assuming the main application directory. Native loadable-library kind is checked for bundled import targets.
